title: Search the tree
goal: Find lines in a log and files in a case folder, without scrolling by hand.

cheatSheet.description: Print lines that contain the literal text ERROR.
Print how many lines matched, not the lines.
Search every file under a directory.
Find files by name. Quote the pattern so the shell does not expand it.
List directories only. -type f is files only.

tasks.prompt: Print the lines in logs/app.log that contain ERROR.
tasks.hint: grep PATTERN file. Without -E the pattern is plain text.

tasks.prompt: Show WARN lines in logs/app.log with line numbers.
tasks.hint: Add -n. The number comes before the line.

tasks.prompt: Count the ERROR lines in logs/app.log. Print the count, not the lines.
tasks.hint: grep -c prints a number. There are three ERROR lines in this file.

tasks.prompt: Search the cases directory for the literal text TODO.
tasks.hint: grep -r walks a directory. The matching path is printed in front of the line.

tasks.prompt: Find every .txt file under your home directory.
tasks.hint: Quote the pattern: find /home/student -name '*.txt'. Otherwise the shell may expand the star first.

tasks.prompt: List the directories under cases, and not the files.
